summary: Regression + new-feature test for HMC after 3 additions (expo-location, photo picker, Stripe payments). BACKEND: 33/33 pytest (24 regression + 9 new). Live location POST /api/auth/location persists lat/lng to user; Stripe POST /api/payments/checkout/session returns valid checkout.stripe.com URL + session_id; GET /api/payments/checkout/status/{sid} returns payment_status/status/amount_total/currency/booking_id for unpaid session; role check (mechanic 403), 404 for unknown booking/session all working. FRONTEND: Login → customer home renders with 'Location off — using default area' warning banner (web permission denied) and 5 mechanic cards via default Mumbai fallback. Booking modal 4-step flow verified: 12 breakdown categories → 6 vehicle options → PHOTO step with pick-camera-button + pick-library-button + photo-back-button + photo-continue-button (label 'SKIP' when no photo). BACK returns to vehicle step; SKIP advances to confirm; SUBMIT navigates to /booking/{id}. /payment-success renders testID + polls & shows 'Payment Not Confirmed' for invalid session (expected). /payment-cancel renders testID + 'Payment Cancelled'. CRITICAL BUG FOUND: on the tracking screen for a COMPLETED (unpaid) booking, a ReferenceError 'payNow is not defined' crashes the screen — the pay-now-button's onPress references a function that was never declared in booking/[id].tsx. This makes the Stripe pay button unusable via the UI (backend endpoints themselves work perfectly via curl).

When a booking is 'completed' and unpaid, the entire tracking screen red-screens (Uncaught Error at booking/[id].tsx:168). Backend Stripe endpoints work; only the client-side handler is missing. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(customer)/booking/[id].tsx:168

rca_of_issue: Reproduction: (1) Login as customer@hmc.app. (2) Create + complete a booking (or use API to reach 'completed' status). (3) Navigate to /(customer)/booking/{id}. Expected: tracking screen shows 'Service Completed' with PAY button. Actual: red-screen error 'payNow is not defined' at booking/[id].tsx:168. Root cause: the JSX `<Pressable onPress={payNow} ...>` references identifier `payNow` that is never declared in the Tracking component scope; JS throws ReferenceError when React tries to evaluate the JSX props during render of the completed-booking branch. Mitigation: declare `async function payNow() {...}` (or `const payNow = async () => {...}`) inside the Tracking component that calls api.checkoutSession + opens the returned URL. The api client, state (paying, setPaying), Linking, and Platform are all already imported so only the function body is missing.
